title: myWorks
summary: A full-screen terminal hub for every project on my machine and on GitHub, built in Rust.
description:
myWorks merges the projects registered on this machine with the repos that only live on GitHub into one keyboard-driven terminal app.

- A sidebar groups projects, a list shows where each comes from (local or GitHub), its branch, uncommitted changes and ahead/behind status, and a details pane shows recent commits and actions.
- `/` filters by name, path, group, tag or language, `R` syncs from GitHub, and `Enter` opens an action menu.
- It compiles to one small binary that starts instantly, and the layout adapts to narrow terminals.
